subject.title: cron: reject webhook URLs with embedded credentials

question: Should cron webhook delivery fail closed on HTTP(S) URLs with embedded userinfo now, and what migration/proof bar is required for existing credentialed webhook jobs?
rationale: The hardening reduces accidental credential exposure, but it intentionally makes previously accepted webhook targets invalid and can stop delivery for existing users without a migration path beyond operator action.

options.title: Require fail-closed with upgrade proof
options.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, preserve redacted warnings and doctor retry behavior, add regression coverage, and require redacted real cron-path proof before merge.

options.title: Keep compatibility default first
options.body: Keep credentialed webhook URLs delivering for now while adding redaction, warnings, or doctor guidance before a later fail-closed change.

options.title: Pause this hardening
options.body: Close or defer this PR if maintainers do not want cron webhook userinfo rejection to change existing delivery behavior yet.

recommendation.title: Require fail-closed with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch onto current main, preserve redacted warnings and doctor retry behavior, add regression coverage, and require redacted real cron-path proof before merge.
